statements.__comment: Reset exposed_internet properties on all OCI DB systems in scope
statements.query: MATCH (n:OCIDbSystem)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:OCICompartment{id: $OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:OCITenancy{id: $OCI_TENANCY_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE n.exposed_internet IS NOT NULL WITH n LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE REMOVE n.exposed_internet, n.exposed_internet_type, n.publicContext RETURN COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted

statements.__comment: Reset exposed_internet properties on the DB nodes of those DB systems
statements.query: MATCH (n:OCIDbNode)<-[:HAS_DB_NODE]-(:OCIDbSystem)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:OCICompartment{id: $OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:OCITenancy{id: $OCI_TENANCY_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE n.exposed_internet IS NOT NULL WITH n LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE REMOVE n.exposed_internet, n.exposed_internet_type, n.publicContext RETURN COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted

statements.__comment: Mark DB nodes as exposed if their VNIC has a public IP and one of its subnet's OWN security lists admits non-ICMP ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 (same test as the instance job)
statements.query: MATCH (dn:OCIDbNode)<-[:HAS_DB_NODE]-(:OCIDbSystem)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:OCICompartment{id: $OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:OCITenancy{id: $OCI_TENANCY_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) MATCH (dn)-[:OCI_VNIC]->(vnic:OCIVnic) WHERE vnic.public_ip IS NOT NULL AND vnic.public_ip <> '' MATCH (subnet:OCISubnet{id: vnic.subnet_id}) MATCH (sl:OCISecurityList) WHERE sl.id IN coalesce(subnet.security_list_ids, []) AND coalesce(sl.allows_internet_ingress, sl.ingress_security_rules CONTAINS '0.0.0.0/0' OR sl.ingress_security_rules CONTAINS '::/0') WITH DISTINCT dn SET dn.exposed_internet = true, (CASE WHEN NOT 'unrestricted_securitylist_ingress' IN coalesce(dn.exposed_internet_type, []) THEN dn END).exposed_internet_type = coalesce(dn.exposed_internet_type, []) + 'unrestricted_securitylist_ingress'

statements.__comment: Mark DB nodes as exposed if their VNIC has a public IP and one of the NSGs attached to THAT VNIC admits non-ICMP ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0
statements.query: MATCH (dn:OCIDbNode)<-[:HAS_DB_NODE]-(:OCIDbSystem)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:OCICompartment{id: $OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:OCITenancy{id: $OCI_TENANCY_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) MATCH (dn)-[:OCI_VNIC]->(vnic:OCIVnic) WHERE vnic.public_ip IS NOT NULL AND vnic.public_ip <> '' MATCH (nsg:OCINetworkSecurityGroup)-[:OCI_NSG_RULE]->(rule:OCINsgSecurityRule) WHERE nsg.id IN coalesce(vnic.nsg_ids, []) AND coalesce(rule.is_internet_ingress, rule.direction = 'INGRESS' AND rule.source IN ['0.0.0.0/0', '::/0']) WITH DISTINCT dn SET dn.exposed_internet = true, (CASE WHEN NOT 'unrestricted_nsg_ingress' IN coalesce(dn.exposed_internet_type, []) THEN dn END).exposed_internet_type = coalesce(dn.exposed_internet_type, []) + 'unrestricted_nsg_ingress'

statements.__comment: Fail-safe: a DB node VNIC with a public IP whose subnet, subnet security lists or NSGs are not in the graph cannot be proven closed, so the DB node is exposed
statements.query: MATCH (dn:OCIDbNode)<-[:HAS_DB_NODE]-(:OCIDbSystem)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:OCICompartment{id: $OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:OCITenancy{id: $OCI_TENANCY_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) MATCH (dn)-[:OCI_VNIC]->(vnic:OCIVnic) WHERE vnic.public_ip IS NOT NULL AND vnic.public_ip <> '' OPTIONAL MATCH (subnet:OCISubnet{id: vnic.subnet_id}) OPTIONAL MATCH (sl:OCISecurityList) WHERE sl.id IN coalesce(subnet.security_list_ids, []) WITH dn, vnic, subnet, count(DISTINCT sl) AS known_security_lists OPTIONAL MATCH (nsg:OCINetworkSecurityGroup) WHERE nsg.id IN coalesce(vnic.nsg_ids, []) WITH dn, vnic, subnet, known_security_lists, count(DISTINCT nsg) AS known_nsgs WHERE subnet IS NULL OR known_security_lists < size(coalesce(subnet.security_list_ids, [])) OR known_nsgs < size(coalesce(vnic.nsg_ids, [])) WITH DISTINCT dn SET dn.exposed_internet = true, (CASE WHEN NOT 'public_ip_unresolved_rules' IN coalesce(dn.exposed_internet_type, []) THEN dn END).exposed_internet_type = coalesce(dn.exposed_internet_type, []) + 'public_ip_unresolved_rules'

statements.__comment: Fail-safe: a DB node whose client VNIC, or whose backup VNIC (when it has one), is not in the graph (GetVnic failed) may have a public IP on it, unless the DB system's subnet (backup subnet for the backup VNIC) is known to prohibit public IPs, so the DB node is exposed
statements.query: MATCH (dn:OCIDbNode)<-[:HAS_DB_NODE]-(sys:OCIDbSystem)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:OCICompartment{id: $OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:OCITenancy{id: $OCI_TENANCY_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) OPTIONAL MATCH (dn)-[:OCI_VNIC]->(known:OCIVnic) WITH dn, sys, collect(known.id) AS known_vnic_ids UNWIND [{vnicId: coalesce(dn.vnic_id, ''), subnetId: sys.subnet_id, required: true}, {vnicId: dn.backup_vnic_id, subnetId: sys.backup_subnet_id, required: false}] AS expected WITH dn, expected WHERE (expected.required OR expected.vnicId IS NOT NULL) AND NOT expected.vnicId IN known_vnic_ids OPTIONAL MATCH (subnet:OCISubnet{id: expected.subnetId}) WITH dn, subnet WHERE coalesce(subnet.prohibit_public_ip_on_vnic, false) = false WITH DISTINCT dn SET dn.exposed_internet = true, (CASE WHEN NOT 'db_node_vnic_unresolved' IN coalesce(dn.exposed_internet_type, []) THEN dn END).exposed_internet_type = coalesce(dn.exposed_internet_type, []) + 'db_node_vnic_unresolved'

statements.__comment: Build publicContext JSON for exposed DB nodes from their own VNICs (client and backup, public ones first) and the open rules that apply to each. resourceType is the inventory service of OCIDbNode (the console's DB system asset).
statements.query: MATCH (dn:OCIDbNode)<-[:HAS_DB_NODE]-(sys:OCIDbSystem)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:OCICompartment{id: $OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:OCITenancy{id: $OCI_TENANCY_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE dn.exposed_internet = true OPTIONAL MATCH (dn)-[:OCI_VNIC]->(vnic:OCIVnic) OPTIONAL MATCH (subnet:OCISubnet{id: vnic.subnet_id}) OPTIONAL MATCH (sl:OCISecurityList) WHERE sl.id IN coalesce(subnet.security_list_ids, []) AND coalesce(sl.allows_internet_ingress, sl.ingress_security_rules CONTAINS '0.0.0.0/0' OR sl.ingress_security_rules CONTAINS '::/0') WITH dn, sys, vnic, collect(DISTINCT sl.id) AS openSecurityListIds OPTIONAL MATCH (nsg:OCINetworkSecurityGroup)-[:OCI_NSG_RULE]->(rule:OCINsgSecurityRule) WHERE nsg.id IN coalesce(vnic.nsg_ids, []) AND coalesce(rule.is_internet_ingress, rule.direction = 'INGRESS' AND rule.source IN ['0.0.0.0/0', '::/0']) WITH dn, sys, vnic, openSecurityListIds, [r IN collect(DISTINCT {nsgId: nsg.id, ruleId: rule.id, protocol: rule.protocol, source: rule.source, tcpPortMin: rule.tcp_dest_port_min, tcpPortMax: rule.tcp_dest_port_max}) WHERE r.ruleId IS NOT NULL] AS nsgRules ORDER BY coalesce(vnic.public_ip, '') <> '' DESC, vnic.id = dn.vnic_id DESC WITH dn, sys, [v IN collect({vnicId: vnic.id, isBackup: vnic.id = dn.backup_vnic_id, publicIp: vnic.public_ip, privateIp: vnic.private_ip, subnetId: vnic.subnet_id, openSecurityListIds: openSecurityListIds, nsgRules: nsgRules}) WHERE v.vnicId IS NOT NULL] AS vnics SET dn.publicContext = apoc.convert.toJson([{resource: dn.id, resourceType: 'oci-database-dbsystem-instance', context: [{dbNodeId: dn.id, hostname: dn.hostname, dbSystemId: sys.id, dbSystemName: sys.display_name, vnicId: vnics[0].vnicId, publicIp: vnics[0].publicIp, privateIp: vnics[0].privateIp, subnetId: coalesce(vnics[0].subnetId, sys.subnet_id), openSecurityListIds: reduce(ids = [], v IN vnics | ids + v.openSecurityListIds), nsgRules: reduce(rules = [], v IN vnics | rules + v.nsgRules), vnics: vnics, exposureTypes: dn.exposed_internet_type, region: dn.region}]}])

statements.__comment: A DB system is exposed when any of its DB nodes is; it carries the union of their exposure types and their publicContext entries
statements.query: MATCH (dn:OCIDbNode{exposed_internet: true})<-[:HAS_DB_NODE]-(sys:OCIDbSystem)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:OCICompartment{id: $OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:OCITenancy{id: $OCI_TENANCY_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WITH sys, collect(dn) AS nodes WITH sys, nodes, reduce(types = [], n IN nodes | types + [t IN n.exposed_internet_type WHERE NOT t IN types]) AS types SET sys.exposed_internet = true, sys.exposed_internet_type = types, sys.publicContext = apoc.convert.toJson([{resource: sys.id, resourceType: 'oci-database-dbsystem', context: [{dbSystemId: sys.id, displayName: sys.display_name, subnetId: sys.subnet_id, exposureTypes: types, dbNodes: [n IN nodes | apoc.convert.fromJsonList(n.publicContext)[0].context[0]], region: sys.region}]}])

name: OCI DB system and DB node asset internet exposure
